source: SAP Discovery Center Business AI catalogue
note: English, text-only snapshot of the Joule Assistants listed in the Discovery Center Business AI catalogue on the capture date. Joule Assistants: domain-scoped multi-agent surfaces that coordinate the linked agents. Detail page: https://discovery-center.cloud.sap/ai-assistant/{uuid}. domain/processes/productCategories codes decode via ai-dictionary.json. Catalogue presence is availability-to-validate with the customer, not an entitlement and not proof of GA. Omission does not establish retirement. Internal ranking/routing fields are not retained. Maintainers replace this copy deliberately; no runtime refresh or API connection.
